s-1.ptxt: Inspect Horn Button Assembly (When Using New Instrument Panel Lower)

s2.ptxt: Vehicles not involved in a collision

s3.ptxt: If any of the following applies, replace the horn button assembly with a new one.

specitem.ptxt: There are cracks, dents or chips on the pad surface of the horn button assembly

s2.ptxt: Vehicles involved in a collision in which the airbag did not deploy

atten2.ptxt: Replace the horn button assembly using the correct procedure.

s3.ptxt: Remove the horn button assembly, and if any of the following applies, replace the horn button assembly with a new one.

specitem.ptxt: There are cracks, dents or chips on the pad surface of the horn button assembly
There are scratches, cracks or damage on the connector and wire harness
The horn button assembly has been dropped

s3.ptxt: If any of the following applies, replace the horn button assembly and steering wheel assembly together with new ones.

specitem.ptxt: The horn button assembly interferes with the steering wheel assembly, making installation of the horn button assembly difficult
The clearance between the horn button assembly and steering wheel assembly when installed is not uniform
The bracket portion of the steering wheel assembly is deformed

atten3.ptxt: If the bracket portion of the steering wheel assembly is deformed, do not repair it; replace it with a new one.

s-1.ptxt: Airbag Warning Light Inspection

s2.ptxt: Check that the warning light comes on when the IG is turned ON.
Check that the warning light goes off approximately 6 seconds after the IG is turned ON.

item.ptxt: If the warning light remains on even after approximately 6 seconds have elapsed after the IG is turned ON, there is a malfunction in the airbag/pretensioner system.

If the light comes on occasionally even after approximately 6 seconds have elapsed after the IG is turned ON, a short to +B, short to ground or open circuit in the airbag warning light circuit may be the cause.
If the light comes on even with the IG OFF or ACC ON, a malfunction in the power supply system or combination meter assembly may be the cause.
